User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the system with a specific role.

uid.description: The unique identifier for the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

name.description: The full name of the user.

condoId.description: The ID of the condominium the user is associated with.

buildingId.description: The ID of the building the user is associated with (for residents).

unitId.description: The ID of the unit the user is associated with (for residents).

id.description: The unique identifier for the condominium.

buildingsCount.description: The number of buildings in the condominium.

equipmentIds.description: The IDs of the equipment associated with the condominium.

userIds.description: The IDs of the users associated with the condominium.

Building.title: Building
Building.description: Represents a building within a condominium.

id.description: The unique identifier for the building.

condoId.description: The ID of the condominium the building belongs to.

floors.description: The number of floors in the building.

unitsCount.description: The number of units in the building.

Equipment.title: Equipment
Equipment.description: Represents a piece of technological equipment (e.g., camera, IP intercom).

id.description: The unique identifier for the equipment.

condoId.description: The ID of the condominium the equipment belongs to.

type.description: The type of equipment (e.g., camera, barrier).

lastMaintenance.description: The date of the last maintenance.

nextMaintenance.description: The date of the next maintenance.

Incident.title: Incident
Incident.description: Represents a reported incident or technical failure.

id.description: The unique identifier for the incident.

condoId.description: The ID of the condominium where the incident occurred.

reporterId.description: The ID of the user (operator) who reported the incident.

technicianId.description: The ID of the technician assigned to the incident.

createdAt.description: The date and time the incident was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time the incident was last updated.

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: Represents a common expense assigned to a unit.

id.description: The unique identifier for the expense.

month.description: The month the expense applies to.

year.description: The year the expense applies to.

id.description: The unique identifier for the facility.

Reservation.title: Reservation
Reservation.description: Represents a reservation for a facility.

id.description: The unique identifier for the reservation.

facilityId.description: The ID of the facility being reserved.

userId.description: The ID of the user who made the reservation.

startTime.description: The start time of the reservation.

endTime.description: The end time of the reservation.

Visitor.title: Visitor
Visitor.description: Represents a planned visitor with a QR code for access.

id.description: The unique identifier for the visitor record.

userId.description: The ID of the resident who invited the visitor.

licensePlate.description: The license plate of the visitor's vehicle (optional).

qrCodeValue.description: The value encoded in the QR code.

PlannedVisit.title: Planned Visit
PlannedVisit.description: Represents a planned maintenance visit by a technician.

id.description: The unique identifier for the planned visit.

description.description: A description of the maintenance tasks.
